user: And the FX spread if I pay in USD?
answer:
Under the Verta tariff schedule, Tier 1 customers pay an **FX spread of 1.5%** over the mid-market rate. This applies only after the free monthly conversion allowance is used up.

- **Free monthly conversion allowance (Tier 1):** EUR 500. If a conversion fits within your remaining allowance, no spread is charged.
- **Spread once the allowance is exhausted:** 1.5% of the converted amount.

I can't see how much of your EUR 500 allowance you've already used this month, so I can't say whether a USD payment would be spread-free. If you tell me the amount you're considering, I can run a full quote showing the mid rate, spread, allowance and final USD amount.

Card payments also carry a separate 1.2% card payment fee on the EUR equivalent, with no flat fee. Whether that applies depends on how you make the USD payment.

fragments.text:
Verta tariff schedule
## FX spreads by tier
The spread is applied over the mid-market rate only after the free monthly
conversion allowance is exhausted.

| Tier | FX spread | Free monthly conversion allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | 1.5% | EUR 500 |
| Tier 2 | 0.9% | EUR 1,000 |
| Tier 3 | 0.5% | EUR 5,000 |

Currency conversion guide
## How a conversion is priced
A conversion quote has these components, in order: the mid-market rate for the
currency pair; the tier spread (a percentage of the gross converted amount);
the free monthly conversion allowance. If the whole conversion fits within the
customer's remaining monthly allowance, no spread is charged. Once the
allowance is exhausted, the full tier spread applies to the conversion.

Fee details
## Card payment fee
Card payments carry a percentage fee on the EUR equivalent. No flat fee
applies.

Verta tariff schedule
## Transfer fees by type
| Transfer type | Flat fee | Percentage fee |
|---|---|---|
| Internal | EUR 0.00 | 0% |
| SEPA | EUR 0.35 | 0% |
| SWIFT | EUR 15.00 | 0.3% |
| Card payment | EUR 0.00 | 1.2% |

The percentage fee is calculated on the EUR equivalent of the transfer amount.
